title: Trading chart
description: A professional trading terminal chart: candles over a gap-free time axis, indicator panes, drawing tools, order lines and real-time streaming, drawn on the GPU and smooth with a million bars.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: TradingChart takes OHLCV bars (objects, or typed-array columns for very long histories) and draws them with the GPU backends of the chart engine; axes, labels, drawings and the crosshair are drawn on a Canvas2D overlay.
overview.axis: The time axis is an index of bars: weekends, nights and holidays leave no holes, and the labels follow the timeframe (new days and months in bold).
overview.panes: Moving averages, Bollinger bands and VWAP go over the price; volume, MACD, RSI, KDJ and ATR get their own pane, all sharing the zoom and the crosshair. Drag a separator to resize a pane.
overview.trading: Last price line with the countdown to the bar close, high / low of the visible bars, buy / sell markers, and order, position, take-profit, stop-loss and alert lines that can be dragged.
overview.drawings: Trend lines, rays, horizontal and vertical lines, rectangles, Fibonacci retracements and a measure tool: plain data, saved and restored through drawings and onDrawingsChange.

streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.text: Call update(bar) on the ref for every tick: a bar at the time of the last one replaces it, a later one appends it. When the latest bar is in view, the chart keeps following it; when the reader scrolled back in history, it stays where it is and a button scrolls back to the latest bar.
streaming.performance: A tick recomputes the indicators for the last bar only and uploads only the last candle to the GPU, drawing on the next animation frame: fifty updates a second cost almost nothing. Zoomed out, bars are aggregated per pixel column, so a million bars draw as fast as a thousand.

controls.title: Controls
controls.pointer: Wheel to zoom at the pointer (Shift or a horizontal swipe to scroll), drag to pan with inertia.
controls.axes: Drag the price axis to zoom it vertically and the time axis to change the bar width; double-click an axis to reset it.
controls.keyboard: Focus the chart: arrows move the crosshair bar by bar (Shift: ten bars) and announce its prices, + / − zoom, Home / End jump to the first / latest bar, Delete removes the selected drawing, Escape cancels.
controls.touch: On touch screens: drag to pan, pinch to zoom.

languages.title: Languages
languages.text: The texts the chart writes (OHLC names, order and alert line titles, countdown, measure tool, accessible names) are built in for English, Chinese, Japanese and French and follow the page language (<html lang>), also when it changes. Volumes use the units of the language (万 / 亿 in Chinese). Set locale to pick another language and labels to replace any text.
languages.colors: Colors don't follow the language: a Chinese page may well show US stocks, so the red-up convention of mainland China stays an explicit colorConvention="redUp".

pro-terminal.title: Pro terminal
pro-terminal.description: Ninety days of one-minute bars aggregated with resampleBars for the timeframe buttons; the toolbar switches the chart style, the indicators and the price scale (auto, percent, logarithmic). Click an indicator name in a legend to hide it, drag a pane separator to resize the panes.

streaming.title: Live streaming
streaming.description: A simulated WebSocket sends fifty trades a second; each one calls update() on the ref with the current one-minute bar. Only the last bar is recomputed and uploaded. The last-price label counts down to the bar close; scroll back in history and the chart stays put until you press the arrow button.

tick-chart.title: Tick chart
tick-chart.description: Every trade is a point of an area chart, about a hundred a second, with a running VWAP and the trade sizes below, colored by the direction of the trade. The time labels switch to seconds on their own.

chart-styles.title: Chart styles
chart-styles.description: chartStyle draws the same bars as candles, hollow candles (hollow when the close is above the open, colored against the previous close), Heikin-Ashi, OHLC bars, a line, an area or a baseline split at the first visible close. The year of daily bars has no weekend gaps.

drawing-tools.title: Drawing tools
drawing-tools.description: Pick a tool, then click twice or drag on the chart. With the cursor, click a drawing to select it, drag it or its handles to move it, press Delete to remove it. drawings and onDrawingsChange keep them in React state, ready to be saved; the Fibonacci retracement and the support line are computed from the data.

orders.title: Orders and positions
orders.description: priceLines draw the open position with its unrealized profit, take profit, stop loss, two limit orders and an alert. Drag a dashed line: onOrderMove reports the new price and the table follows. The arrows are the trades of the history, from markers.

compare.title: Compare symbols
compare.description: compare draws other symbols over the price; with the percent scale every series starts at 0% on the first visible bar, so performances can be compared while scrolling. The logarithmic and linear scales are there to see why.

history.title: Infinite history
history.description: The chart starts with the last 200 hourly bars. When the oldest bar comes into view, onHistoryRequest fetches the 200 before it and prependBars inserts them without moving the view.

million-bars.title: 1,000,000 bars
million-bars.description: Two years of one-minute bars as Float64Array columns, with a 200-period EMA. Zoomed out, the bars are aggregated per pixel column, so showing all of them is as fast as showing a hundred.

red-up.title: Red up, green down
red-up.description: colorConvention="redUp" follows the mainland China, Hong Kong, Japan and Korea conventions; utcOffset shows the times of the Shanghai exchange. MA5 / 10 / 20 / 60, volume with its MA5 and KDJ, as on a Chinese brokerage app. The convention is not inferred from the page language (a Chinese page can show US stocks): set it explicitly.

dark-terminal.title: Dark terminal
dark-terminal.description: The chart takes its colors from CSS variables: a wrapper redefines them for an exchange-style dark terminal with a ticker header, EMA 20 / 50, Bollinger bands, volume at the bottom of the price pane and RSI.

TradingChartProps.height: Height in pixels or any CSS length
TradingChartProps.width: Width in pixels or any CSS length
TradingChartProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
TradingChartProps.ref: Imperative handle: streaming (update, appendBars, prependBars), scrolling and drawings
TradingChartProps.onCrosshairMove: The crosshair moved to another bar or price; null when it left the chart
TradingChartProps.onClick: A pane was clicked (not while drawing)
TradingChartProps.onVisibleRangeChange: The visible bars changed: scroll, zoom, resize or new bars
TradingChartProps.onOrderMove: A draggable price line was dropped at a new price: update your order there
TradingChartProps.onDrawingsChange: The user added, moved or deleted drawings; pass the array back as drawings
TradingChartProps.onDrawingSelect: The selected drawing changed (its id, or null)
TradingChartProps.onDrawingToolChange: The drawing tool changed, e.g. back to cursor after a drawing
TradingChartProps.onIndicatorToggle: An indicator was shown or hidden from its legend
TradingChartProps.onHistoryRequest: The oldest bar came into view: load older bars and call prependBars
TradingChartProps.onRendererChange: The backend in use, again after a fallback (GPU reset)

TradingChartOptions.bars: Bars, oldest first: objects or typed-array columns. A new array with the same history and newer bars is applied as a stream
TradingChartOptions.timeframe: Duration of a bar ("1m", "4H", "1D" or milliseconds): time labels, countdown and drawings beyond the last bar. Inferred from the bars by default
TradingChartOptions.symbol: Name shown in the legend and the accessible label
TradingChartOptions.chartStyle: How the bars are drawn: candles, hollowCandles, heikinAshi, bars, line, area or baseline
TradingChartOptions.indicators: Indicators: averages, Bollinger bands and VWAP over the price, the others in panes below, in this order
TradingChartOptions.scaleMode: Price scale of the price pane: linear, log or percent (from the first visible bar)
TradingChartOptions.colorConvention: greenUp (most markets) or redUp (China, Japan, Korea): swaps the default up / down colors. Not derived from the locale: set it explicitly
TradingChartOptions.upColor: Color of rising bars, any CSS color including var()
TradingChartOptions.precision: Decimals of the prices; detected from the data by default
TradingChartOptions.formatPrice: Formats the prices of the axis, legend and labels (overrides precision)
TradingChartOptions.locale: Locale of the texts, numbers and dates: the page language (<html lang>, followed when it changes) by default
TradingChartOptions.utcOffset: Offset of the displayed times from UTC in minutes (480 for UTC+8); local time by default
TradingChartOptions.crosshair: magnet snaps the horizontal line to the open, high, low or close; free follows the pointer
TradingChartOptions.legend: Legends with the values at the crosshair and the indicator toggles
TradingChartOptions.lastPriceLine: Dotted line and axis label at the last price
TradingChartOptions.countdown: Time left until the current bar closes, under the last price label
TradingChartOptions.highLowMarkers: Marks the highest and lowest prices of the visible bars
TradingChartOptions.markers: Buy / sell arrows with an optional text and trade price
TradingChartOptions.priceLines: Order, position, take-profit, stop-loss and alert lines; draggable ones report onOrderMove
TradingChartOptions.compare: Other series drawn over the price, best read with the percent scale
TradingChartOptions.drawings: Drawings (controlled): replaced when a new array is passed
TradingChartOptions.drawingMode: Active drawing tool; cursor selects and moves drawings
TradingChartOptions.keepDrawingMode: Keeps the tool after a drawing instead of going back to cursor
TradingChartOptions.baselinePrice: Price splitting the baseline style; the first visible close by default
TradingChartOptions.rightOffset: Empty space after the last bar, in bars
TradingChartOptions.barSpacing: Initial width of a bar in pixels
TradingChartOptions.wheel: Mouse wheel: zoom, modifier (Ctrl / ⌘ only, the page scrolls otherwise) or none
TradingChartOptions.kineticScroll: Keeps panning after a quick drag
TradingChartOptions.watermark: Large faint text behind the bars
TradingChartOptions.labels: Overrides of the built-in texts (English, Chinese, Japanese and French are built in)
TradingChartOptions.renderer: Backend: auto picks WebGPU, then WebGL2, WebGL and Canvas2D
TradingChartOptions.ariaLabel: Accessible label; built from the symbol by default

TradingChartHandle.update: Streams a bar: the time of the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it
TradingChartHandle.appendBars: Appends bars newer than the last one
TradingChartHandle.prependBars: Inserts older bars before the first one; the view stays on the same bars
TradingChartHandle.setBars: Replaces the bars and scrolls to the latest one
TradingChartHandle.getBar: Bar at an index, null outside the data
TradingChartHandle.scrollToRealtime: Scrolls to the latest bar (animated by default)
TradingChartHandle.getVisibleRange: Visible bars as logical indices and times
TradingChartHandle.setVisibleRange: Shows the bars between two logical indices
TradingChartHandle.resetPriceScales: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again
TradingChartHandle.selectDrawing: Selects a drawing (null clears the selection)
TradingChartHandle.setIndicatorVisible: Shows or hides an indicator by id
TradingChartHandle.getRenderer: Backend in use, null until ready

TradingBar.time: Opening time in milliseconds since the epoch

TradingPriceLine.kind: order, position (with its unrealized profit), takeProfit, stopLoss, alert or line: sets the default look
TradingPriceLine.side: buy or sell: colors orders and positions like rising / falling bars
TradingPriceLine.title: Label of the line; a short default per kind
TradingPriceLine.quantity: Quantity next to the label; numbers also give positions their profit
TradingPriceLine.color: Color; from the kind and side by default
TradingPriceLine.draggable: Can be dragged to another price, reported by onOrderMove
TradingPriceLine.lineStyle: solid, dashed or dotted; dashed for orders by default

TradingMarker.time: Time of the bar (the bar containing it)
TradingMarker.side: buy draws an up arrow under the bar, sell a down arrow above it
TradingMarker.price: Trade price, marked with a dot
TradingMarker.text: Short text next to the arrow
TradingMarker.color: Color; the up / down color by default

TradingCompareSeries.name: Name in the legend
TradingCompareSeries.data: Values by time, matched with the bars
TradingCompareSeries.color: Line color; a theme color by default

TradingDrawing.points: Anchors (time and price): one for horizontal / vertical lines, two otherwise
TradingDrawing.color: Color; the primary color by default
TradingDrawing.locked: Can't be moved nor deleted by the user

TradingDrawingPoint.time: Time; past the last bar it is extrapolated with the bar duration

TradingChartLabels.change: Name before the change of the bar in the legend (none in English)
TradingChartLabels.volume: Volume in the legend and title of the volume pane
TradingChartLabels.scrollToRealtime: Label of the button scrolling back to the latest bar
TradingChartLabels.toggleIndicator: Accessible label of the legend toggles; {name} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.bars: Bar count of the measure tool; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.days: Days of the measure tool and the countdown; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.hours: Hours of the measure tool and the countdown; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.minutes: Minutes of the measure tool; {count} is replaced
TradingChartLabels.announcement: Bar read aloud when the keyboard moves the crosshair; {time}, {open}, {high}, {low} and {close} are replaced
TradingChartLabels.timeframe: Timeframe after the symbol in the legend; the timeframe option when it is a string by default

TradingCrosshairEvent.index: Index of the hovered bar (may be past the last bar)
TradingCrosshairEvent.bar: Hovered bar, null outside the data
TradingCrosshairEvent.price: Price, or indicator value, at the horizontal line
TradingCrosshairEvent.pane: Hovered pane: price or the indicator id
TradingCrosshairEvent.x: x of the crosshair in pixels
TradingCrosshairEvent.y: y of the horizontal line in pixels

TradingClickEvent.price: Price, or indicator value, at the pointer

TradingOrderMoveEvent.price: New price, rounded to the price precision

TradingVisibleRange.from: Logical index at the left edge
TradingVisibleRange.to: Logical index at the right edge

candles.title: Candles, moving averages and panes
candles.description: Daily candles with two moving averages, volume and RSI panes; texts and dates follow the page language.

streaming.title: Real-time streaming
streaming.description: A tick every 500 ms updates the last bar and every tenth opens a new one, without passing the data again.

props.options: Other engine options (TradingChartOptions of minerva-design/charts/core: colors, texts, locale, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-crosshair-move: The crosshair moved; detail: { time, index, bar, price, pane, x, y }, null when it left the chart
events.minerva-click: A pane was clicked; detail: { time, index, price, pane }
events.minerva-visible-range-change: The visible bars changed; detail: { from, to, fromTime, toTime }
events.minerva-order-move: A draggable price line was dropped at a new price; detail: { id, price, previousPrice, line }
events.minerva-drawings-change: The user added, moved or deleted drawings; detail: { drawings }
events.minerva-drawing-select: The selected drawing changed; detail: { id }
events.minerva-drawing-tool-change: The drawing tool changed (back to cursor after a drawing); detail: { tool }
events.minerva-indicator-toggle: An indicator was shown or hidden from its legend; detail: { id, visible }
events.minerva-history-request: The oldest bar came into view: load older bars with prependBars; detail: { firstTime, count }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.updateBar: Streams a bar: the time of the last bar replaces it, a later time appends it (the update(bar) of the engine)
methods.appendBars: Appends bars newer than the last one
methods.prependBars: Inserts older bars before the first one, keeping the view
methods.getBar: Bar at an index, null outside the data
methods.getVisibleRange: Visible bars, null before the engine is created
methods.setVisibleRange: Shows the bars between two logical indices
methods.resetPriceScales: Fits every price scale to the visible bars again
methods.setDrawingTool: Activates a drawing tool (cursor, trendLine, horizontalLine, fibRetracement…)
methods.selectDrawing: Selects a drawing (null clears the selection)
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
